title: Vulnerable LLM Agent: record a tool-boundary experiment
license_review: Apache-2.0 source license read. Model licenses and optional provider terms are separate.
check_meaning: Record a legitimate account request, an injected request and the actual tool arguments/outcome across at least three trials. This records an experiment; neither a single refusal nor a flag establishes robust authorization across prompts or models.
availability_reason: Needs pinned application dependencies and model digest, measured model disk/RAM, and repeated local-model trials. Upstream dependencies include unpinned packages and published payloads; the listed model names do not imply a working or free provider integration.

runtime_acceptance: Pinned dependency lockfile and model digest/license
Synthetic tools/data and reviewed execution boundary
Actual download, expanded weights, RAM/VRAM, CPU and latency measurements

integration.start: Select and hash a suitable local Ollama model, resolve/review a dependency lockfile, then start the app in an isolated local workspace with only synthetic fixture data. Optional paid model providers require a separate explicit configuration and budget.
integration.check: Save model parameters and repeated paired baseline/injection traces. Do not infer a pass from generated text without the corresponding tool call.
integration.stop: Stop the app and its selected local model process; retain prompts, traces and configuration separately from model cache.
integration.reset: Export work before discarding the owned environment and restoring its reviewed baseline. No reset is automated until lifecycle acceptance passes.
integration.export: Keep full traces and model weights locally. Import this bounded manual observation report with model/dependency hashes and trial count.
integration.destroy: Remove only the owned app workspace/runtime and unused owned model cache; preserve notes/traces. Never prune a shared Ollama model store globally.

instructions: Record a legitimate account request, an injected request and the actual tool arguments/outcome across at least three trials. This records an experiment; neither a single refusal nor a flag establishes robust authorization across prompts or models. Use lab plan for requirements and the exact report template. Imports are manual practice observations and never enable runtime execution.
